script:
INT. COMMUNITY KITCHEN - MORNING
Volunteers bustle in a sunlit community kitchen, chopping vegetables and stirring large pots. MAYA (20s, cheerful) kneads dough at the counter while her grandfather SAM (70s, calm) tastes a soup and nods slowly.
MAYA: (laughing) Too much pepper again, grandpa?
SAM: (smiling) Never too much. Just enough to remember.
The doors open and a line of neighbours streams in with empty bowls and full smiles.
user_requirement: Warm and fast-paced, no more than 8 shots.
